ghi_chu: Lop sang tach bang luat mau tu anh goc, cung kich thuoc va vi tri voi anh goc (chong khit). Mau giu nguyen, sang hon ~12%, co quang mem. Danh sach chua_lam: phan sang trung mau voi khung vang/than nen khong loc duoc bang mau, can gen bang ChatGPT theo PROMPT-LOP-SANG.md.
ghi_chu_dot_2: 27 anh gen bang ChatGPT tren nen den, da chuyen nen den thanh trong suot (alpha = do sang), thu ve 512 va can vao anh goc. Phan sang la hinh VE LAI nen co the lech 1-3 px so voi chi tiet goc.
